selection_rule: Ascending numeric priority (default 100), then task ID; only not_started tasks with verified complete dependencies, fresh successful main CI, no open-PR overlap, no active claim, and no clinical gate.
clinical_boundary: Empty clinical reviewer allowlist means no automatic clinical approval verification. Configure accountable reviewers only through a reviewed policy PR. Synthetic demo tasks need no unrelated clinical dependency.
legacy_evidence: Stage 1 receipts are retained unchanged but not silently upgraded into independently verified Stage 2 completion receipts. Reconcile and append missing evidence through review.
technical_review_boundary: Engineering completion may use exact-head required CI plus immutable evidence without a second human code reviewer because this repository currently operates as a single-maintainer project. This does not authorize clinical approval, product acceptance, or bypass of clinical gates.
